facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 3 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on LA-7201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on LA-7201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 13 March 2023 an incident occurred on LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
